packaging.scope: Darwin arm64 artifacts when present. Node tarball excludes dependency downloads and Node runtime; Rust npm installation downloads main plus platform packages. Installed Node dependency tree bytes exclude Node runtime and filesystem allocation overhead.

rust.source: Native release libsqlite3.a build-artifact proxy; not queried from the installed CLI

method.coldDefinition: Application SQLite cache removed; OS filesystem cache is not cleared
method.execution: Paired sequential runs on identical source files; backend order alternates per iteration. Team builds and heavy tests are paused during formal measurement; unrelated system workloads are not controlled.
method.timings: performance.now wall clock; HTTP TTFB means fetch headers resolved; complete includes response body read, excludes JSON parse
method.bodyBytes: Decoded UTF-8 response body bytes after fetch automatic decompression; not wire transfer bytes
method.appendVisibility: Wall time from synchronous append until 25 ms polling observes the marker in the full detail response; includes observer request/body/JSON work. appendPublishedMs separately waits for the expected head timestamp and full message count before full-payload parity
method.cliPeakRss: /usr/bin/time OS high-water RSS for one-shot process
method.webPeakRss: Sampled ps RSS every 200 ms: observed maximum, not OS high-water RSS
method.steadyRss: Median of five ps RSS samples after 2 seconds idle
method.idleCpu: ps cumulative CPU delta over approximately 2.5 seconds; coarse centisecond resolution
method.latencyP95: Aggregated endpoint request observations, not five startup samples
method.sqliteCompileOptions: Node options queried from frozen module; Rust options queried from native release static build archive (proxy, not installed CLI). SQLite writer version also read from each cache file header
method.writeBytes: Actual physical/logical write volume and parser/query counts not instrumented; cacheBytes is final on-disk cache size only
unmeasured: Installer decompression time and transitive Node dependency download bytes
Per-query query plan and physical read/write counters
No-op refresh parser/query counts and burst-change memory recovery
Backfill queue depth and concurrent append latency during backfill
Dashboard/project latency on private production histories
Cold OS-page-cache search and detail latency
method.equivalence: Full canonical JSON digests for CLI, list, search, Unicode search, detail and appended detail; no fields removed. Dynamic cursors can trigger reported mismatches; they are not silently dropped.

Usage: codesesh [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -j, --json                     
  -a, --agent <AGENT>            
  -d, --days [<DAYS>]            [default: 7]
  -p, --port <PORT>              
      --host <HOST>              [default: 127.0.0.1]
      --remote-access            
      --tls-cert <TLS_CERT>      
      --tls-key <TLS_KEY>        
      --trust-proxy

      --noOpen                   
      --cwd <CWD>                
      --from <FROM>              
      --to <TO>                  
  -s, --session <SESSION>        
      --trace                    
      --no-cache                 
      --cache [<CACHE>]          [default: true] [possible values: true, false]

  -V, --version                  Print version

Discover, aggregate, and visualize AI coding agent sessions (codesesh v1.0.12)

USAGE codesesh [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

          -p, --port=<port>    HTTP server port (Default: 4521)                                                          
              --host=<host>    HTTP server bind address (default 127.0.0.1, local access only) (Default: 127.0.0.1)

      --tls-cert=<tls_cert>    Path to a TLS certificate; serve remote access over HTTPS                                 
        --tls-key=<tls_key>    Path to the TLS private key matching --tls-cert                                           
              --trust-proxy    A reverse proxy in front of CodeSesh terminates TLS (Default: false)                      
  --public-url=<public_url>    Public HTTPS origin served by the trusted reverse proxy                                   
        -a, --agent=<agent>    Filter to specific agent(s), comma-separated                                              
          -d, --days=<days>    Only include sessions active in the last N local calendar days (0 = all time) (Default: 7)
                --cwd=<cwd>    Filter to sessions from a specific project directory (use '.' for current dir)            
              --from=<from>    Sessions active on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (overrides --days)                      
                  --to=<to>    Sessions active on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)                                       
    -s, --session=<session>    Directly open a specific session (agent://session-id)                                     
                 -j, --json    Output session index as JSON to stdout (no server) (Default: false)                       
                   --noOpen    Don't auto-open browser (Default: false)                                                  
                    --trace    Show performance trace logs (Default: false)                                              
                    --cache    Use cached scan results if available (Default: true)                                      
                 --no-cache                                                                                              
              --clear-cache    Clear scan cache before starting (Default: false)

assessment.measuredFrom: Extracted package/bin/codesesh from the packaged Darwin arm64 npm platform artifact; manifest hash matched
assessment.thresholdSource: docs/rust-migration-plan.md:313: no unexplained significant regressions; no universal numerical speedup target. regressionScreen > 1.2 is diagnostic only.

remainingTradeoff.diagnosis: The Rust request reads 600 session heads in one consistent SQLite snapshot; separate profiling measured roughly 3.4 ms for that snapshot read. The observed additional request latency is retained as an explicit consistency-read cost.
remainingTradeoff.decision: Retain the consistent read and record the approximately 3.3 ms p95 overhead; do not claim every endpoint accelerated or change comparison thresholds.

resolvedRegressions: Repeated per-result search highlight regex compilation replaced with reuse per unique query term
Project/dashboard aggregation recomputation removed by generation-aware cached aggregates
assessment.scope: Synthetic local macOS arm64 measurements only; unmeasured scenarios remain listed in methodology.unmeasured. No raw samples or business fields normalized.
